syncEngine.notes: Exact pin on the reviewed 6.16 minor line. No caret/tilde and no launch-time npx.

hostRuntime.bundledNodePolicy: Use Electron's embedded Node via ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE for the owned sync child. Launch must not require a global Node or floating npx.

setupToolchain.scope: Private per-userData toolchain created by guided Linux x64 setup. Does not mutate the system Node install or shell profile.

git.notes: Installer dependency (deb Depends: git). Setup refuses to continue without an absolute /usr path executable.

rejectedAdapters.reason: Pins hq-cloud major 5; incompatible with the reviewed 6.16 sync engine line used by this companion.
Declares hq-cloud ^5.1.0; cannot share one compatible sync engine with @indigoai-us/hq-cloud@6.16.35.

linux.notes: Owned ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE child with private IPC stop + lock release; unit SyncSupervisor stop ownership; scripts/verify-sync-child.mjs packaged probe. Workspace registry persists root/environment/installationId atomically with alias + dual-ownership checks (tests/native/workspaces.test.ts). Credential lifecycle: PKCE loopback + Cognito verify, OS safeStorage with basic_text fail-closed, desktop account.encrypted isolated from ~/.hq/cognito-tokens.json, sign-out clears owned credentials without deleting workspace files (tests/native/auth.test.ts).

windows.notes: Native Windows host matrix remains outstanding (including Windows Credential Manager / DPAPI acceptance); prepare-runtime records the gap without blocking Linux acceptance.

wsl2.notes: WSL discovery module returns actionable unavailable/missing/stopped states and rejects WSL1 via injectable parser tests. Live Windows WSL2 picker + runtime ownership remain US-014; not claimed from Linux fixtures. Auth handoff into a distro is US-014.
